name: Lotse Taring
description: A raw, rangy man tried for stealing nine baskets of apples from Jigme Village's reserve, later blamed for poisoning the elder.

timeline.summary: The court hears the case against Lotse Taring, accused of stealing nine baskets of apples; Kela and Dar listen in deep meditation.
timeline.quote: Nine baskets of apples had been stolen from the Village reserve.

timeline.summary: Kela leaves her lamp unlit; Dar lights his, and the villagers declare Lotse guilty.
timeline.quote: Lotse was guilty. Dar had lit his lamp.

timeline.summary: The villagers blame Lotse for poisoning the elder and storm the prison to kill him.
timeline.quote: She was poisoned!" This voice was loud and sure. "It was the apples!

timeline.summary: Kela leaps between Lotse and a warrior's sword, demanding that he receive a trial.
timeline.quote: He should have a trial," she whispered.

timeline.summary: Dar announces that Lotse will have a fair trial, and the girl from the tree rings the gong.
timeline.quote: The man will have a fair trial," Dar said.

relations.note: He is tried and jailed in Jigme Village.
relations.quote: Today, we hear the case of Lotse Taring against the Jigme Village.
